units.source_text: 七段有个习惯，就是一边对局，一边喋喋不休地说些无聊的笑话。

en.t: The seventh-dan player had a habit: while playing a game, he would chatter on endlessly, telling silly jokes.

units.source_text: 名人却佯装听不见，不予搭理。

en.t: The Master, however, pretended not to hear him and paid him no attention.

units.source_text: 他唱独角戏，也就没劲儿。

en.t: With only himself performing, he soon found it dull.

units.source_text: 同名人对局时，也只好比平时少说几句了。

en.t: When playing against the Master, he had no choice but to talk less than usual.
